end.parentNote: Mahi practised identifying the north and south ends of a suspended magnet and began discussing a simple compass. They correctly used the N label and later stated that Earth behaves like a giant magnet. The mix-up that the needle points north because the North is cold was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, ask Mahi to explain why a freely suspended magnet settles north–south, using Earth’s magnetic effect rather than temperature.
